info.title: OctoCAT Supply Chain Management API
info.description:
REST API for the OctoCAT Supply Chain Management System. This API provides comprehensive endpoints for managing suppliers, products, orders, deliveries, and organizational structures including headquarters and branches.

## Features

- **Complete CRUD Operations** - Create, Read, Update, Delete for all entities
- **Relational Data** - Properly linked entities with foreign key relationships
- **Type Safety** - Strong TypeScript typing throughout
- **Error Handling** - Consistent error responses with appropriate HTTP status codes
- **SQLite Backend** - Lightweight, file-based database with full ACID compliance

## Error Handling

All endpoints follow a consistent error response format:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "ERROR_CODE",
    "message": "Human-readable error message"
  }
}
```

### Error Codes

- `NOT_FOUND` (404) - Requested resource does not exist
- `VALIDATION_ERROR` (400) - Invalid input data
- `CONFLICT` (409) - Resource conflict (e.g., duplicate entry)
- `DATABASE_ERROR` (500) - Internal database error

## Data Model

The API manages the following core entities:

- **Suppliers** - Provide products to the supply chain
- **Products** - Items available for order
- **Headquarters** - Main company locations
- **Branches** - Regional offices linked to headquarters
- **Orders** - Purchase orders from branches
- **Order Details** - Line items within orders
- **Deliveries** - Shipments from suppliers
- **Order Detail Deliveries** - Links between orders and deliveries

## Getting Started

1. Start the API server: `npm run dev --workspace=api`
2. Access this documentation at: `http://localhost:3000/api-docs`
3. Try the endpoints using the "Try it out" feature

For more information, see the [API Documentation](https://github.com/webmaxru/copilot_agent_mode/tree/main/docs) in the repository.

delete.description: Deletes a supplier from the system. Note: This will also delete all products associated with this supplier (CASCADE delete).
